title: Shop UI: single owned instance; kill 4-way rebuild, canvas leak, dead group lookup, click-outside cart discard
description: ShopUI rebuilt by merchant.gd:542, quest_giver.gd:965, innkeeper.gd:287, conversation_system.gd:1532; traveling_merchant.gd:305 group 'shop_ui' never joined (shop never opens); invisible full-rect button (shop_ui.gd:76) discards cart on edge click; ShopUICanvas leaks on reopen (merchant.gd:544). Evidence: ux_designer.md

title: Desert lag: perf quick wins (global enemy cap, boundary rocks, water planes, shared materials)
description: Root causes: 45-175 rock StaticBodies per impassable edge (wilderness_room.gd:2721-2760), stacked fullscreen alpha water planes (cell_streamer.gd:708-779), 90-144 active enemies vs 20 budget (wilderness_room.gd:2081-2100, per-cell cap only). Cap globally ~24 preserving difficulty via enemy quality; clusters 15-25 to 3-5; consolidate water planes; shared static materials. Evidence: performance_engineer.md

title: Thieves guild soft-locks at rank 2 (thieves_08_rival_gang choice objective uncompletable)
description: type:'choice' objective has no completion path; blocks entire questline past rank 2. Its kill/sabotage/negotiate design is the best branching content in the game, all dead data. Evidence: game_designer_quests.md

title: Arena: nothing calls _complete_tournament after wave 5
description: arena_master.gd:305 returns early; _on_wave_complete has no final-wave check. Victory/fame/unlock never fire. Evidence: systems_designer_arena.md BUG-2

title: Arena: fix kill-count wiring (group removed before entity_killed emit)
description: gladiator_npc.gd:284 removes tournament_enemy group BEFORE emitting entity_killed at :287; tournament_manager.gd:282 requires the group, so wave 1 never completes. Move removal after emit. Evidence: production/war_room/analysis/systems_designer_arena.md BUG-1

title: Fix within-scope broken quest-giver/turn-in NPC ids
description: Known: thornfield_guard_captain (breaks 5 quests), guildmaster_nightshade should be lady_nightshade (breaks 4 endgame thieves quests), mage_aldric_dalhurst, elric_thornwood, borin_stonehammer, high_chronist_thornfield. Validator tool produces full list; fix within-scope only. Evidence: dialogue_quest_master.md

title: Sprite size standard: pixel_size = target_height / frame_height formula + migration
description: 180+ scattered pixel_size constants on sheets with 96/64/48px frame heights = inconsistent world scale. Anchor: humanoid 0.0256@96px (~2.46m, most common at 42 uses). Fix h_frames mismatches (lady_in_red.png 386x96, wizard_mage.png 277x96). Migrate via audit table, eyeball per NPC class - no blind replace. Evidence: asset_validator.md

title: Scope cut to Act I: gate below-the-line zones + scrub references
description: Release scope: Elder Moor, Thornfield, Dalhurst, Millbrook, Crossroads, Willow Dale, Bandit Hideout, Sunken Crypts, Arena. Gate Kazan-Dun/Aberdeen/Larton/Whaelers/Falkenhaften/elf/pirate to Act II. Reframe out-of-scope place mentions as distant rumor (LORE_ONLY). Re-stage main quest hook to Dalhurst cliffhanger (Aldric Vane). Evidence: discussion.md scope debate, synthesis.md

title: Dialogue depth: activate archetype/unique response tiers + persistent anti-repeat
description: register_archetype_response()/register_unique_response() (conversation_system.gd:850-864) never called - all NPCs share ~7 generic pools (local_news 62, rumors 63, personal 76, directions 42, trade 20, quests 20). discussed_responses resets every start_conversation(); npc_memory populated but never consulted by filter. Wire tiers, persist anti-repeat. Evidence: dialogue_quest_master.md

title: Wire APPLY_CHOICE_CONSEQUENCE dialogue action (activates 37 dormant quests)
description: QuestManager.apply_choice_consequence() (quest_manager.gd:1625) has zero callers; 37 quests with authored choice_consequences are inert incl. keepers_confrontation 4-ending finale. Add dialogue action calling it. MUST be followed by consequence QA pass (~3-4d) - never-executed content is never-tested content. Evidence: game_designer_quests.md

title: BasePopupUI + UIManager autoload + shared Theme (ADR-003 enforcement)
description: Base class with FULLSCREEN/DIALOGUE/COMPACT size classes; UIManager owns one layer-100 CanvasLayer, modal stack, refcounted pause. One shared Theme resource (16 popups currently: 3 margin schemes, 9 palettes, 6 cloned button stylers). Migrate shop, bounty board, enchanting, crafting first; dialogue box + game menu are the reference standard, not migration targets. Evidence: ux_designer.md

title: Content validator tool: resolve all quest/NPC/location/enemy references
description: Editor/CI tool: every quest giver_npc_id, turn_in_target, objective target, location id, enemy id, next_quest must resolve against WorldGrid, spawned NPCs, enemy .tres, quest files. LORE_ONLY whitelist for distant-place mentions. Run AFTER scope cut. Root cause of: 113/204 uncompletable reach objectives, 8+ broken quest givers, arena quests targeting 4 nonexistent enemies, phantom places. Evidence: dialogue_quest_master.md, discussion.md Theme 2

title: Bounty board UI: margins, column expand, process mode, reparent off 3D node
description: 20px margins vs standard 60/80; fixed 280/320px columns without SIZE_EXPAND_FILL (:116,:127); root lacks PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS; canvas parented to 3D board (bounty_board.gd:412) can strand game paused with mouse captured. Evidence: ux_designer.md

title: EnchantingUI/SpellMakerUI render under HUD; crafting stations do not pause
description: Both CanvasLayers have no layer set (default 1, HUD is 2). Crafting/enchanting never pause tree - enemies attack mid-craft. Evidence: ux_designer.md

title: Desert encounter table references nonexistent enemies (60%)
description: giant_scorpion/snake/sand_wurm in encounter_manager.gd:109-114 missing from ENEMY_SPAWN_CONFIG - silent failures + warning spam. Evidence: performance_engineer.md

title: Arena: barrier/teleport/spike-pit fixes (timebox 3d total or gate arena)
description: Between-wave teleport places player OUTSIDE barrier; barrier mis-scaled with corner gaps; enemies path into spike pit with no kill floor and stall waves. If timebox blows, gate arena 'closed for repairs' (~2-4h). Evidence: systems_designer_arena.md BUG-3/4/6

title: Flagship branching quests: 2-3 per faction (~16 total; 10 have dormant branch data)
description: Rebuild adventurers_04_bandit_contract as second showcase. Target factions: adventurers, thieves, iron_company, arcane_circle, keepers, temple, bandits. Evidence: game_designer_quests.md

title: Flagship quest: Millbrook bandit takeover (kill/bribe/negotiate/join/usurp)
description: The canonical multi-path quest on established lore - Millbrook is already written as bandit-controlled town player slowly discovers. All five paths per the Summoner's example. Template: hub resolve objective + optional path objectives + boss dialogue with skill_check/take_gold/complete_quest_objective/set_flag - 80% works on current systems. Evidence: game_designer_quests.md, Desktop/broken provinces thoughts.txt Millbrook section

title: Quest engine: OR-objectives, pre-completion flags, bandit faction, boss-lite ongoing effects
description: OR-objective groups (3-4d); flag-based pre-completion detection (2-3d); bandit faction resource + join mechanics (1-2d, currently zero bandit quests/faction); generalize daily-penalty ticker to ongoing income/effects for boss-lite play (2-3d). ~2wk total. Evidence: game_designer_quests.md

title: Sprite regeneration wave via new 3D-to-2D pipeline
description: Regenerate worst-offender NPC sprites with the new 3D-model-to-sprite workflow, sized via the standard formula. Depends on sprite standard task.
